I saved the Tansley Parcel deadline in the knowledge brain: the signed order form is due 25 August, noted as coming from Pree in #central-team.

I replied to Pree in her #central-team thread to confirm it was saved, and flagged one problem. Today is 14 October, so if she meant 25 August this year, that date has already passed. I asked whether she meant August 2027 or whether the form is now overdue.

I couldn't check the date against anything. The shared Tansley Parcel folder has no files, and the brain had nothing else about this deadline. Its search is keyword-only, so it can miss differently worded notes. I took no other action, as she asked.
